title: A Note of Thanks to Deb Autor
summary: Beginning in January 2027, Deb will transition from her full-time executive position while continuing to serve as a member of our Board of Directors and assuming the role of Chair of the Quality & Safety Committee.
body_markdown:
She joined our Board of Directors in November 2024, bringing extraordinary experience in regulatory affairs, public policy, and corporate leadership. A year later, I was thrilled when she agreed to expand her involvement with Hims & Hers by joining us full-time as Chief Policy Officer.


Today, I want to share that, beginning in January 2027, Deb will transition from her full-time executive position while continuing to serve as a member of our Board of Directors and assuming the role of Chair of the Quality & Safety Committee that oversees work related to the quality, safety, and reliability of our products, services, and clinical and pharmacy operations. She will also serve as an Executive Advisor to Hims & Hers. In these capacities, we will continue to benefit from her extensive experience, independent judgment, and deep understanding of our business and the regulatory and policy landscape. Few directors bring Deb's combination of corporate governance experience and hands-on executive leadership, and we look forward to her continued contributions to our strategic initiatives and long-term success.


In just over a year as Chief Policy Officer, Deb built our first regulatory affairs function from the ground up and significantly strengthened our public policy and government affairs capabilities. During and following our acquisition of Eucalyptus, she played an important role in navigating the global regulatory and policy landscape and establishing an international policy presence in the United Kingdom. She accomplished all of this with tremendous energy, sound judgment, and a deep commitment to our mission and the people we serve. The foundation she has built will serve Hims & Hers well for years to come.


Deb's contributions extend well beyond the functions she established and the initiatives she led. She has helped shape our approach to complex regulatory and policy issues, strengthened our relationships with important stakeholders, and brought an invaluable perspective to our executive leadership team. Her experience, integrity, and ability to navigate challenging issues have made her a trusted colleague and an important part of our company's growth.


Deb cares deeply about Hims & Hers and believes strongly in our mission. At this point in her career, and with other goals she’s excited to pursue, Deb has decided that the Board, Committee Chair, and advisory roles are the right fit for her. I am grateful that we will continue to benefit from her experience, leadership, and perspective.


As we look ahead, the strong team Deb has assembled and developed—including our government and public affairs and regulatory affairs functions—will join our legal and compliance organization, led by Soleil Boughton, our Chief Legal Officer. This transition will allow us to build upon the foundation Deb has established and continue advancing the important work of these excellent teams.


Deb, thank you for your extraordinary contributions, your commitment to our mission, and the leadership you have brought to Hims & Hers. We are grateful for everything you have accomplished and look forward to your continued service, independent judgment, and invaluable perspective.
